*@X!dun%;UEnk3d-M]MS.text: To add a new flag...1) Make a list containing the hex codes (without the '#') of the colors of your flag. If some of the colors should be bigger than others, put multiple of the same color in a row (see the "bi flag" list for an example). Not sure how to get hex codes? Google "hex color picker"2) Create a costume for your flag icon3) Change the "when i recieve show color options" script to repeat the right amount of times4) Make a block called "load <your flag>" and model the script off of the other block scripts5) Change the "when I start as clone" script to have an if-else that includes your flag and calls the right load block
